scope: Two published TGS 2017 demonstration avatar costume adaptations, one view each.
catalogue_status: R-SURVIVE-AVATAR remains open; these do not cover all custom avatar genders, faces, loadouts, equipment or final-game variants.

source.provenance: Screenshot carrying Konami copyright, published within 4Gamer TGS2017 hands-on report. Article confirms four demo presets, but individual identities/roles are not labeled in this frame.

primary_corroboration.notes: Official PlayStation Japan publication shows the same group outfits in a smaller 640x360 lobby image; seen in browser. Used for corroboration only, not role attribution.

duplicate_check.finding: Existing costume is black knit cap, respirator, charcoal short-sleeved T-shirt, blue trousers, dark bracers, spear. Both proposed demo costumes differ. P43 listed costumes are Eva, Haven Trooper, Naked Snake fatigues/sneaking suit and The Boss sneaking suit.
